datasets.name: RS-LL dataset (Potential Loess Landslide Dataset)
datasets.source: State Key Laboratory of Geohazard Prevention and Geo-environment Protection
datasets.verbatim: we employed a remote sensing dataset of potential loess landslides [see Fig. 5(d)] with ambiguous boundaries, which is sourced from the optical images of Google Earth and created by the geological experts of State Key Laboratory of Geohazard Prevention and Geo-environment Protection.

datasets.name: CIFAR-10 dataset
datasets.verbatim: CIFAR-10 showed in Fig. 9 is an established computer-vision dataset used for image classification, which consists of 60,000 images with 10 object categories and 6000 images per category.

datasets.name: MS-COCO dataset
datasets.verbatim: MS-COCO shown in Fig. 1(a) is a popular dataset for object detection, containing 91 common object categories with 82 of them having more than 5000 labeled samples.

datasets.name: ImageNet dataset
datasets.verbatim: the pretrain models learned on the ImageNet dataset [32] are used to initialize the backbones of the evaluated object detectors.

methods.name: Improved Mask R-CNN
methods.summary: An improved Mask R-CNN detector for objects with ambiguous boundaries, created by removing the segmentation branch from the original Mask R-CNN and embedding a channel-wise attention module into the ResNet-101 backbone.
methods.verbatim: To improve Mask R-CNN for detecting objects with ambiguous boundaries, we first removed the segmentation branch to eliminate the unfavorable effect of local level learning and then embedded the channel-wise attention module in the ResBlock of the ResNet-101 backbone to exploit more discriminative information in the channel domain.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and other input datasets are mentioned but not linked or made available, and the custom code for the improved Mask R-CNN is not provided via any repository or persistent link.
